prayerExcerpt.en-US: Amid the uncertainties of this world may we hasten towards you with minds made pure.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Entre as vicissitudes deste mundo, corramos ao vosso encontro com pureza de coração.

meta.face: A German prince of about forty-five with a fair, ruddy complexion and a SHORT, BROAD, HEART-SHAPED face — a wide, rounded forehead and full, wide cheeks tapering to a small, rounded chin under the beard; a short, straight nose with a rounded tip; wide-set, light hazel eyes under gently arched light-brown brows; a small, full mouth; chestnut-brown hair cut level at the ears in the Ottonian manner beneath the crown; a short, rounded chestnut beard and moustache trimmed close to the jaw; a mild, earnest, devout look. Not the stock thirties man with curls: straight, level-cut hair and a heart-shaped face.
meta.basis: The coronation page of the Regensburg Sacramentary (1002-14), made for him in his lifetime, shows Henry crowned, in a golden tunic and blue mantle, with brown hair cut at the ears and a short dark beard. He died at fifty-one at Bamberg, whose diocese and cathedral he founded; the structure of the face is our choice.
